faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSL Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSL Faculty recruitment is 01 October 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Faculty post at CSL?
faq.answer: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the Faculty positions. These are distributed across different specializations as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CSL Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 400. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to CSL Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Faculty posts at Cochin Shipyard Limited is 65 years. There are no specified minimum age limits mentioned in the data provided.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for CSL Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Faculty positions at CSL will primarily involve a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Faculty (Electro Technical Officer) post?
faq.answer: The Faculty (Electro Technical Officer) position on a contract basis offers a monthly salary of Rs. 85,000. For other faculty roles, the salary is negotiable.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post, including degrees in Mechanical, Electronics, or Electrical Engineering, and specific Certificates of Competency as Marine Engineer Officer Class I or Master Mariner (Foreign Going).

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job at CSL?
faq.answer: The recruitment for these Faculty positions at Cochin Shipyard Limited is on a contract basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the contract agreement.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for CSL Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the full notification before applying.

faq.question: Q10. How do I apply for the CSL Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official CSL website or the provided 'Apply Online' link. Ensure all details are accurate and required documents are uploaded before the closing date.
